    30→// VerifyEIP1559Header verifies some header attributes which were changed in EIP-1559,
    31→// - gas limit check
    32→// - basefee check
    33→func VerifyEIP1559Header(config *params.ChainConfig, parent, header *types.Header) error {
    34→	// Verify that the gas limit remains within allowed bounds
    35→	parentGasLimit := parent.GasLimit
    36→	if !config.IsLondon(parent.Number) {
    37→		parentGasLimit = parent.GasLimit * config.ElasticityMultiplier()
    38→	}
    39→	if err := misc.VerifyGaslimit(parentGasLimit, header.GasLimit); err != nil {
    40→		return err
    41→	}
    42→	// Verify the header is not malformed
    43→	if header.BaseFee == nil {
    44→		return errors.New("header is missing baseFee")
    45→	}
    46→	// Verify the baseFee is correct based on the parent header.
    47→	expectedBaseFee := CalcBaseFee(config, parent)
    48→	if header.BaseFee.Cmp(expectedBaseFee) != 0 {
    49→		return fmt.Errorf("invalid baseFee: have %s, want %s, parentBaseFee %s, parentGasUsed %d",
    50→			header.BaseFee, expectedBaseFee, parent.BaseFee, parent.GasUsed)
    51→	}
    52→	return nil
    53→}
    54→
    55→// CalcBaseFee calculates the basefee of the header.
    56→func CalcBaseFee(config *params.ChainConfig, parent *types.Header) *big.Int {
    57→	// If the current block is the first EIP-1559 block, return the InitialBaseFee.
    58→	if !config.IsLondon(parent.Number) {
    59→		return new(big.Int).SetUint64(params.InitialBaseFee)
    60→	}
    61→
    62→	parentGasTarget := parent.GasLimit / config.ElasticityMultiplier()
    63→	// If the parent gasUsed is the same as the target, the baseFee remains unchanged.
    64→	if parent.GasUsed == parentGasTarget {
    65→		return new(big.Int).Set(parent.BaseFee)
    66→	}
    67→
    68→	var (
    69→		num   = new(big.Int)
    70→		denom = new(big.Int)
    71→	)
    72→
    73→	if parent.GasUsed > parentGasTarget {
    74→		// If the parent block used more gas than its target, the baseFee should increase.
    75→		// max(1, parentBaseFee * gasUsedDelta / parentGasTarget / baseFeeChangeDenominator)
    76→		num.SetUint64(parent.GasUsed - parentGasTarget)
    77→		num.Mul(num, parent.BaseFee)
    78→		num.Div(num, denom.SetUint64(parentGasTarget))
    79→		num.Div(num, denom.SetUint64(config.BaseFeeChangeDenominator()))
    80→		if num.Cmp(common.Big1) < 0 {
    81→			return num.Add(parent.BaseFee, common.Big1)
    82→		}
    83→		return num.Add(parent.BaseFee, num)
    84→	} else {
    85→		// Otherwise if the parent block used less gas than its target, the baseFee should decrease.
    86→		// max(0, parentBaseFee * gasUsedDelta / parentGasTarget / baseFeeChangeDenominator)
    87→		num.SetUint64(parentGasTarget - parent.GasUsed)
    88→		num.Mul(num, parent.BaseFee)
    89→		num.Div(num, denom.SetUint64(parentGasTarget))
    90→		num.Div(num, denom.SetUint64(config.BaseFeeChangeDenominator()))
    91→
    92→		baseFee := num.Sub(parent.BaseFee, num)
    93→		if baseFee.Cmp(common.Big0) < 0 {
    94→			baseFee = common.Big0
    95→		}
    96→		return baseFee
    97→	}
    98→}
